method.corpus: ~/dm3-extract/store-dm3/trajectory_samples, filter map='dm3' AND format='mvd' AND mode='4on4' (the cohort route-lab's human medians were measured on)
method.node_match: |x-nx|<=64 AND |y-ny|<=64 AND |z-nz|<=80; a sample matching several nodes is assigned to the NEAREST (resolves the two overlapping boxes ya/tele_ya_in and rl/spawn4)
method.visit: consecutive same-node samples collapsed to one visit (t_start=first, t_end=last sample in the node box)
method.transit: consecutive DISTINCT node visits A->B within one (demo_key,slot) timeline, dt = t_start(B)-t_end(A) <= 15 s; DIRECT because no other of the 24 nodes was visited in between
method.life_guard: transit rejected if any life boundary falls in (t_dep, t_arr]: spawns-table event (route-lab same_life_routes semantics), frags row with the slot as victim (death), or a non-teleport position discontinuity (step >250 u at >2500 u/s)
method.speed_glitch_filter: additionally, non-tele transits whose implied speed exceeds 2500 u/s over the minimum possible displacement max(node_centre_dist-160,0) are rejected (632 transits) — these are respawn/parser glitches that land exactly on a degenerate zero-length interval and escape the boundary predicate; the 160 u slack means adjacent/overlapping node boxes (rl/spawn4) are never falsely flagged
method.teleport: jumps from within 160 u of a tele-in pad landing within 160 u of its tele-out pad are NOT life breaks; edges into a tele_out with med_s<0.25 are kind 'tele' (covered by game mechanics, the movement part is the approach to the pad). This includes ya->tele_ya_out: the ya box overlaps the tele_ya_in box and nearest-node assignment sends most YA-tele departures to 'ya' (med 0.032 s == teleport). All other arrivals at a tele_out have med>=0.5 s and are genuine movement
method.coverage: edge COVERED if (from,to) matches an identified route's endpoints; PARTIAL if hand-curated sub-segment or z-weighted (z*3, dm3 is a vertical maze) straight-line betweenness (via/base <= max(1.35, 1+200u/base)) of a covered route; else MISSING; edges with n_demos<20 are LOW_SUPPORT and not classified
method.identified_route_mapping_notes: window=tele_ya_out (registry window start 1328,544,44); tunnel=spawn2 (registry tunnel start IS spawn2 at 192,-208,-176); lifts~spawn6 (crossing centre 508,610,182 is 160 u from spawn6, generous); sng/spawn->quad = spawn1/spawn5->quad (registry pools both SNG-tele spawns)
